海辛（Hyacinth），一位在实验电影、人工智能生成内容（AIGC）和虚拟艺术领域拥有丰富经验的创意人士和导演。目前担任MorphStudio的视频产品负责人，猫眼电影的签约导演，DemolnnShanghai 主理人，并且是第25届上海国际电影节创投评委。曾任Midjourney中国社区及内容负责人。 
她的职业生涯横跨电影制作、动画、AI艺术创作以及教育领域。在2024VisionOS开发者大会、阿里巴巴 
U设计周等多个国际会议和峰会上作为嘉宾分享对AIGC和虚拟艺术的见解；在清华大学美术学院、北京电影学院等多个知名大学和培训机构教授关于AI艺术和影视制作的课程；作为一位虚拟艺术家，她的作品多次在国际电影节上展映并获得提名和奖项，包括AI实验动画和短片。

Hyacinth is a creative professional and director with extensive experience in experimental film, AI-generated content (AIGC), and virtual art. She currently serves as the Head of Video Products at MorphStudio, a signed director at Maoyan Film, the curator of DemolnnShanghai, and a jury member for the 25th Shanghai International Film Festival Pitch and Catch. She was formerly the Head of the Midjourney China Community and Content. 
Her career spans film production, animation, AI art creation, and education. She has been a guest speaker at international conferences and summits, including the 2024 VisionOS Developer Conference and Alibaba's U Design Week, sharing insights on AIGC and virtual art. She also teaches courses on AI art and film production at renowned institutions such as Tsinghua University’s Academy of Arts & Design and the Beijing Film Academy. As a virtual artist, her works have been showcased at international film festivals and have received multiple nominations and awards, including AI experimental animations and short films.
